Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: revised transparent character animation atlas for a personal watch app.
Input image 1 is the edit target: Patrick Star in navy formal jacket, round black glasses, white shirt, red tie, green floral shorts, holding a small cream spiral notepad. Input image 2 is ONLY a seated body-proportion and clean cel drawing reference; do not copy its pajamas, hat, pillow or yawning.
Redraw target as a clean sixteen-frame animation sheet, FOUR columns by FOUR rows. Repair the compressed torso: give the seated body natural belly and jacket volume below the face, while keeping Patrick recognizable and keeping head/face size constant through all sixteen drawings. The last row must not shrink. Preserve the outfit, glasses, notepad, coral skin, white sclera, black pupils and coral eyelids. Serious, slightly deadpan personality.
Sequence: 1 attentive neutral holding notepad; 2 gaze drops to notes; 3 thoughtful squint; 4 glasses start sliding down; 5 notices; 6 looks over lowered glasses; 7 right arm begins lifting naturally from jacket sleeve; 8 fingertips approach outside glasses rim; 9 gently pushes the rim upward without covering or crossing through an eye; 10 pushes to normal position; 11 hand starts lowering; 12 hand midway down; 13 returns hand to notepad; 14 slight satisfied closed-mouth smile; 15 blink; 16 returns exactly to the first neutral drawing. Notepad remains supported by the other arm throughout.
Fixed camera, identical anatomical dimensions and identical feet baseline in all cells, no zoom, no per-frame stretching. Every full character has generous transparent space around head and feet and between neighbors; approximately 65% cell height. Soft thick starfish arms, consistent wrist thickness and continuous sleeve contact, exactly two arms and two feet. Actual distinct limb and facial drawings; no whole-body swaying. Clear flat 2D cel colors and black outlines close to the supplied art. Transparent alpha background, no grid, labels, numbers, detached specks, realistic textures or added props.
